# Qamar sideload APK (tester build)

Phone file: `qamar-0.9.0-arm64.apk` (arm64, 0.9.0+12).

Wired to the live Supabase project `stqirjlqzchcoeegumoq`. Debug-signed; do not merge this branch into `main`.

## Install
1. On GitHub, open `qamar-0.9.0-arm64.apk` and tap Download.
2. Allow Install unknown apps for the browser or Files.
3. Open Qamar. You should get an anonymous session.

Typed / spoken / barcode logging is free. Photo logging and non-today plans need Qamar+. Ask Qamar uses the 5/day cap.
